title: Payload-agnostic core
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, Generating a QR Code.

statements.label: Payload-agnostic core
statements.requirement: The modules for steps 3 to 9 SHALL NOT depend on any payload logical model. Payloads SHALL be plugged in through a PayloadCodec registered against a subclaim.

sources.quote: The container, the signature and the transport encoding are the same for every GDHCN trust domain ... What changes from one use case to the next is only the payload
